_comment: Illustrative reward milestones (simulated, nothing is actually redeemable). Points per card come from 'card_points' by card type: base 5, legend 25, any other card (special, collector, context) 10. A card earned at the stadium (a stadium edition) is worth 'stadium_multiplier' times as much. The milestones are spread over the full collection (about 1,650 points without the stadium bonus): the first is reachable in the first days, the last takes most of the tournament.
